general_notes: Per state the candidate set follows the same pattern: one target-with-border, one blurred copy, one zoomed crop in a vignette, one unrelated 3D render, and four full-figure in-app vignette versions that differ mainly in how much backdrop/embers/smoke survives. Differences among the four vignette variants are subtle and my distinctions between them carry uncertainty. Motion was judged from six still frames only; frame-to-frame differences are small in all sequences, so plausibility and expressiveness scores are conservative and timing/smoothness could not be judged. The depleted target contains a flat grey rectangle at bottom right that looks like a retouch; candidates that omit it were not penalised on character dimensions.
